name: arachidonate 12-lipoxygenase, 12R type

function.text: ALOX12B encodes arachidonate 12-lipoxygenase, 12R-type. Annotated molecular activities include arachidonate 12(R)-lipoxygenase activity and arachidonate 12(S)-lipoxygenase activity. It participates in lipid oxidation and lipoxygenase pathway.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis 2 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

function.text: ALOX12B encodes arachidonate 12-lipoxygenase, 12R-type. It participates in lipid oxidation and lipoxygenase pathway. Functional annotations also associate the protein with arachidonate 12(R)-lipoxygenase activity and arachidonate 12(S)-lipoxygenase activity.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis 2 (autosomal recessive).
